title: GAD Scaling Ledger Entry
description: Schema for recording honest system growth: base models, adapters, routers, and assemblies with parameter counts and evaluation results

entry_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this ledger entry

entry_type.description: Classification of what this entry represents

model_or_system_id.description: Canonical name of the model or system (e.g., 'Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct' or 'gad-coder-7b-canonical')

ts_added.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this entry was added to the ledger

base_model.description: Reference to the base model (HF Hub ID or internal ID) this entry depends on. For base_model entries, reference self.

base_params.description: Number of parameters in the dense base model

adapter_params.description: Sum of all trainable adapter parameters (LoRA, prefix tuning, etc.)

adapter_count.description: Number of separate adapters active in this entry

oneOf.description: Human-readable param count or range (e.g., '7B routed', '3B sparse')

active_params_default.description: Default active parameters for typical inference call (may be range if routed)

active_params_max.description: Maximum active parameters in any single call (base + largest routed adapter)

total_deployed_params.description: Sum of base + all deployed adapters + fallback models (total system footprint)

trainable_params_last_run.description: Number of parameters that were trainable in the most recent training run

route_policy.description: How adapters are combined: router picks one, merged into base, stacked sequentially, or single adapter only

fallback_models.description: List of fallback model IDs available if primary routes fail

additionalProperties.description: Benchmark score as decimal (0.0-1.0 for percentages, or raw score)

evals.description: Benchmark results map: benchmark_name -> score (decimal 0.0-1.0 for percentages)

cost_per_success.description: USD cost per successful task (for cost-efficiency sorting)

latency_p50_ms.description: Median latency in milliseconds for inference

fallback_rate.description: Fraction of requests that fall back to secondary routes (0.0 = no fallbacks, 1.0 = all fallback)

promotion_status.description: Current status in the promotion pipeline

rejection_reason.description: If status is 'rejected', explanation for why (e.g., 'regression at 3B', 'data leakage risk')

decision_refs.description: Array of decision IDs that reference or justify this entry

notes.description: Free-text notes on training, methodology, caveats, or context
